title: Onboarding Fees and Seeding Targets by Tier — Continuum Backup & Recovery
content:
Onboarding a Continuum Backup & Recovery plan has two tier figures that are fixed in money and one fixed in time: the one-time onboarding fee per contracted server, the minimum one-time onboarding fee, and the target number of calendar days to complete seeding, the initial full backups of the protected devices.

## Schedule

| Tier | Onboarding fee per contracted server (USD) | Minimum onboarding fee (USD) | Seeding target (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 0 | 0 | 7 |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 0 | 0 | 7 |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 95 | 250 | 10 |
| Continuum BDR | 195 | 750 | 14 |
| Continuum DRaaS | 395 | 1500 | 21 |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 595 | 3500 | 30 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The per-server figure is a one-time fee per contracted server, that is, per server of the server commitment on the order; the minimum figure is the lowest one-time onboarding fee the tier charges.
2. On Continuum Backup Basic and Continuum Backup Standard both onboarding figures are zero, so those tiers have a zero onboarding fee.
3. The seeding figure is a target number of calendar days to complete seeding, stated in whole days.
